name: Site day
description: The working uniform: waxed field jacket over a thermal henley, cargo pants, moc-toe boots.

name: Weekend layers
description: Flannel overshirt under the corduroy chore coat with selvedge jeans and suede chukkas.

name: Cold snap
description: Fisherman sweater over the henley, quilted vest on top, carpenter pants and boots; herringbone scarf.

name: Soft shell
description: Shawl-collar cardigan as the outer layer with a flannel shirt, jeans and a bridle belt.

name: Summer utility
description: Work shorts with the thermal henley, boots and the waxed tote.

name: Harbour walk
description: Camp-collar linen shirt open over the ribbed tank, drawstring pants, espadrilles and the straw hat.

name: Terrace lunch
description: Striped linen shirt with pleated linen shorts, leather slides and round sunglasses.

name: Golden hour
description: The slip dress under the unlined linen blazer with leather slides and a silk scarf at the neck.

name: Market morning
description: Linen wrap skirt with the ribbed tank and open-knit polo over it, espadrilles, basket bag.

name: Shirt dress day
description: Linen shirt dress belted with the braided belt, sandals and the straw hat.

name: Jumpsuit in the city
description: Utility jumpsuit with espadrilles and round sunglasses; the linen blazer over the shoulders.

name: Black tie
description: Satin-lapel tuxedo jacket, tuxedo trousers, cashmere turtleneck instead of a shirt, patent loafers.

name: Gala
description: Column gown under the velvet cape with strappy heels, the box clutch and opera gloves.

name: Dinner
description: Silk tie-neck blouse tucked into the satin pencil skirt, sheer tights and patent loafers.

name: Boardroom
description: Double-breasted blazer over the cashmere turtleneck with fluid wide-leg trousers and loafers.

name: Cocktail hour
description: Satin camisole under the double-breasted blazer, tuxedo trousers, strappy heels.

name: Winter evening
description: Camel overcoat over the black-tie look; slim silk tie with the tuxedo jacket.

name: Tuxedo and denim
description: The Evening line's tuxedo jacket worn with the Utility line's selvedge jeans and suede chukkas; an AnyCompany Apparel signature mix.

name: Linen and tailoring
description: The Resort camp shirt under the Evening line's double-breasted blazer, with drawstring linen pants and loafers.
